reasoning: By the Pigeonhole Principle, it is impossible to place 17 pigeons into 16 holes with each hole containing at most one pigeon. The maximum capacity is 16 pigeons (one per hole), but we need to place 17, so at least one hole would need to hold 2 or more pigeons, violating the constraint. This problem is UNSATISFIABLE.
